purpose: Constructed one-participant Gaussian random-intercept/random-slope case for which direct-change reliability is 0.20 and total fitted-slope determinacy is 0.80.

estimand.target: random slope on centered linear time
estimand.units: response units per one time unit

construction_notes: The nuisance trajectory for the direct estimator is the participant-specific intercept only.
The direct estimator is the participant-only GLS/BLUE slope contrast that annihilates H_i and does not use G.
With centered times -0.5 and 0.5 and R_i = 2 I, the direct contrast is [-1, 1] and its residual error variance is 4.
The full-model conditional covariance is computed independently from (G^{-1} + Z_i' R_i^{-1} Z_i)^{-1}; its target-slope conditional variance is 0.20, giving D_slope2 = 1 - 0.20 / 1 = 0.80.
Delta_fit is derived only after R_direct and D_slope2 have been computed independently.
